title: Events do not fire for hidden components since gradio v5.36+
body:
### Describe the bug

since version 5.36.2 the users don't see the gradio initialized. they can see the gradio page but the app is not running.
using this method to launch the app:

```
        os.environ['no_proxy'] = ' ,'.join(all_ips)
        interface.queue(default_concurrency_limit=interface_concurrency_limit).launch(show_error=debug_mode, server_name=interface_host, server_port=interface_port, share=is_gui_shared, max_file_size=max_upload_size)

```
### Have you searched existing issues?  🔎

- [x] I have searched and found no existing issues

### Reproduction

pip install 'gradio>5.36.0'



### Logs

```shell
Index.svelte:373 Failed to execute 'postMessage' on 'DOMWindow': The target origin provided ('https://huggingface.co') does not match the recipient window's origin ('http://192.168.1.10:7860').
(anonymous) @ Index.svelte:373Understand this warning
manifest.json:1  Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
```

### System Info

```shell
ALL
```

### Severity
very high
I can not work around it

comments.body:
OK I found the issue, the component JSON has its "change" event not fired anymore since gradio version 5.36.2

here is a minimal script test JSON component change event:

```py
import gradio as gr

# 1) Python callback that runs when the JSON changes
def screen_data(data):
    # data is the object returned by your JS
    ts = data.get("timestamp", "unknown time")
    msg = data.get("message", "")
    return f"At {ts}, JS says: “{msg}”"

with gr.Blocks() as demo:
    # Hidden JSON to capture the raw JS return value
    hidden_json = gr.JSON(visible=False)
    # Visible Textbox to show the screened output
    display     = gr.Textbox(label="Screened Output")

    # 2) demo.load() uses only JS to populate hidden_json
    demo.load(
        fn=None,
        js="""
        () => {
            const data = {
                message: "Hello from client JS!",
                timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
            };
            return data;  // this goes into hidden_json
        }
        """,
        outputs=[hidden_json]
    )

    # 3) When hidden_json changes (i.e. immediately after load), run screen_data
    hidden_json.change(
        fn=screen_data,
        inputs=[hidden_json],
        outputs=[display]
    )

demo.launch()

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Ah so the issue is that the events for _any_ hidden components don't fire anymore. If you change `visible=True` in `gr.JSON()`,  it'll work. Let me discuss with the team what a good fix for this would be. I'll reopen. By the way, in the meantime, you could use a component like `gr.State` instead of `gr.JSON`

comments.body:
Yeah okay. This is expected and was never explicitly supported and actively discouraged. We do not version the DOM generated by gradio and encourage people not to rely on it for this exact reason. 

To achieve this kind of behaviour you should do it via gradio, or if you must do this kind of thing then do not attempt to interact with components that aren't visible.
